judgment.quote_A: So, it will take approximately 60 minutes for both workers to fill 25 boxes together.
judgment.quote_B: Multiplying both the numerator and denominator by 12 (the least common multiple of 4 and 6) gives us: 150 minutes.
judgment.reason: Answer A correctly calculates the combined rate (5/12 ≈ 0.417 boxes/min) and derives 60 minutes for 25 boxes, showing units and ending with a complete sentence.
